description: Out-of-sample evaluation of the whole BIR pipeline vs a fair public/state-of-the-art baseline per dataset, plus a rough calibration sanity-check of the predictive se, and a committed markdown results doc. Datasets: Boston (MASS, medv, regression), synthetic_large (reproducible generator defined below), solubility (AppliedPredictiveModeling, WIDE ~951x228), spam (kernlab, binary type as numeric 0/1). Uses the installed bucketimpute package from FEAT-001.
steps: Create evaluation scripts under /projects/sandbox/earth/bucketimpute/inst/eval/ (committed). One driver plus per-dataset logic so each dataset can be run as a SEPARATE timed invocation. Set a fixed seed (e.g. set.seed(2024)) for reproducibility.

Define the synthetic_large generator EXACTLY as specified (document it in the script and results doc): seed 2024, n=4000, p=40; x columns ~ runif or rnorm as appropriate; y = 5*x1 + 4*max(x2-0.3,0) + 3*max(0.5-x3,0) + 2.5*x4*x5 + 1.2*x6 + N(0,1); x7 = x1 + N(0,0.25); x8 = x2 + N(0,0.25); remaining columns pure noise. (max(...) applied elementwise, i.e. pmax with 0.)

For each dataset, do an OUT-OF-SAMPLE comparison (held-out test split, e.g. 70/30 with fixed seed, or outer CV): train fit_bir(x_train, y_train, n=10 default) and predict on x_test (type='all' to also get se). Baseline per dataset: plain earth (earth(x_train, y_train)) and/or bagged earth (caret::bagEarth) — pick a consistent, fair state-of-the-art choice per dataset and state it. Report OOS RMSE for BIR vs baseline.

spam: treat binary `type` as numeric 0/1 and evaluate by RMSE. Note that quantile bucketing a two-value y triggers the distinct-buckets ERROR from fit_bir at n>=2; capture that error and report it as an EXPECTED, reportable outcome (NOT a bug). Do not force a workaround that alters the method.

solubility (WIDE, p=228): BIR fits n*p = ~2280 earth models per fit on thin buckets (p>>rows-in-bucket). Run under a hard timeout with a small smoke test first. If full-size n=10 is impractical/hangs, report the cost honestly and optionally include a clearly-labeled smaller-n or subsampled run instead of hanging. Always record whether it completed and the wall-clock cost.

Calibration sanity-check of se: on the datasets that run, check whether larger predicted se correlates with larger actual |residual| (e.g. Spearman correlation of se vs abs error, or binning se into quantiles and comparing mean abs error per bin). Report the finding honestly.

Run each dataset as its own timed invocation with hard timeouts (Rscript with a wall-clock guard; use the bash `timeout` command). Capture RMSE numbers, wall-clock, and any errors/timeouts to a results file. Write throwaway run logs under the repo but keep only the final results doc + eval scripts in git.

Write the results doc /projects/sandbox/earth/bucketimpute/inst/eval/BIR-evaluation-results.md (committed): summarize the method (including the lars substitution), the exact evaluation protocol (splits/seeds), a table of OOS RMSE BIR vs baseline per dataset, the se calibration finding, wall-clock costs, and HONEST verdicts including where BIR loses to the baseline and any datasets that could not run (spam distinct-buckets error; solubility cost if applicable).
acceptance_criteria: Evaluation scripts exist under bucketimpute/inst/eval/ and are reproducible (fixed seeds).

OOS RMSE reported for BIR vs a stated baseline for Boston and synthetic_large at minimum; solubility either completes (with cost recorded) or its cost/impracticality is reported honestly with an optional labeled smaller run; spam's distinct-buckets error is captured and reported as expected.

A committed markdown results doc BIR-evaluation-results.md contains: method summary (noting lars), protocol, RMSE comparison table, se calibration finding, wall-clock costs, and honest verdicts including losses and non-runnable datasets.
Evaluation uses out-of-sample data (held-out/CV), NOT in-sample affinities.
No run logs or build artifacts left staged in git beyond the eval scripts and results doc.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/earth && timeout 600 Rscript bucketimpute/inst/eval/<boston-run>.R 2>&1 | tail -30 (confirm BIR + baseline RMSE printed)
Confirm BIR-evaluation-results.md exists and contains a populated RMSE comparison table (not placeholders).
